title: Pristinia Walls
dek: Pristinia’s defenses carry the history of shared construction, battle recovery, repair and continuing civic work.

facts.Completion: Several phases; no single final date established
facts.Authority: Contributions do not establish ownership or civic command

body:
Defenses built by many hands

The April 2024 description presents the walls as unfinished but already improved by many workers. Alyhotep uses earth-shaping magic, with animals hauling materials; Ryvyt follows others’ work with Mending to correct imperfections. There is no basis here for assigning the whole defense to one founder. Earlier completion accounts and later construction references should be read as layers of work, repair and expansion rather than one final date for every fortification.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3.

Wren returns for her bow

After a battle nearly kills her, Wren returns to find the longbow she left behind. Alyhotep has recovered it while tending the dead and gives it back. Wren worries that others blame her for the attack; Alyhotep reassures her that the struggle is older and larger than her. Her fear and his reassurance belong to their recovery from the battle, not to a proven explanation of what caused it.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Safety requires more than fighting

Dale borrows a farmer’s plow to make a drainage ditch and asks Pappy for help with the harness. Pappy’s first question is where the water will go; Dale has not decided. Elsewhere, Alyhotep and Olokun discuss growing demand on resources and the need for infrastructure, trade and organization. These scenes show practical problems being worked through, not a completed drainage system or an enacted economic program.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

Later work on the defenses

In August 2025, Farkur begins planning a guard tower and asks Spicy to record the materials used. In September he checks masonry, identifies weak mortar and brings supplies to restore the site. Nymera arrives with smithing and masonry tools to help strengthen it. These are specific preparations and contributions; the known accounts do not certify that every proposed tower, gate or weapon was finished.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Order, protection and the right to decide

The 10 September 2025 source posts show Severina tying ropes around logs while Kaelen works on the wall. She describes disciplined order as the basis of endurance; he emphasizes protecting the people the builders care about. These are two interpretations of the work, not an official civic doctrine.

Pappy arrives dragging hand-carved support beams while objecting to what he sees as an attempted Hellknight takeover. He is contributing to the fortification, not opposing its existence. Severina says she seeks order rather than control and apologizes if her discipline is perceived as intrusion. Their cooperation does not settle the political disagreement.

Plans and a guard tower appear in the exchange, and Spicy later describes acting as supervisor that day. The broader record already establishes Farkur’s earlier guard-tower planning. That contribution is preserved without assigning every wall phase to him, treating one disputed reference as proof that his plans were left there, or declaring the complete design and authorization settled.

A later phase of an older defense

September’s work comes after the earlier communal wall-building and quest attacks recorded in Pristinia’s history. It cannot replace those events as the town’s first fortification. Logs, ropes, repairs and tower preparation show continuing effort; they do not supply a final surveyed layout, staffing roster or completion date.
